metadata.label: pursuit / reactive / seed 4
metadata.purpose: Actual closed-loop neural rollout from original-conditioned gait windows. Planner selects targets; model does not receive scene geometry.
limitations: Kinematic generation; no dynamics or collision solver.
Collision metrics use a conservative root proxy, not whole-body shape clearance.
A target is replanned every 0.5 seconds, and unused predicted futures are discarded.
C08/BREK grounding is a separate displayed retarget correction; raw G1 is retained.
